newsitem.title: POLAND: Rolimpex ups milling mkt share to 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Rolimpex ups milling mkt share to 10 pct.

text.p: Polish food producer and trader Rolimpex SA believes last week's purchase of a mill near Warsaw will increase its market share in milling to about 10 percent from 7-8 percent, Rolimpex president said on Monday.

Roman Mlyniec told Reuters that the purchase of a 83.5-percent stake in a new firm Mlyny Warszawskie Sp z o.o. would allow Rolimpex to increase flour production of its units to 350,000 tonnes per year from current 270,000 tonnes.
"Milling is one of our core businesses...and after the purchase we have about 10 percent market share," he said.
Mlyniec said Rolimpex, which now owned eight mills in Poland, had no plans for further purchases of mills.
